reviewed_by: Codex manual Radare2 instruction and x86 candidate review, 2026-10-19

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Manually inspected retail 0x004CF300..0x004CF323 with Radare2. Existing independent BN/r2 CFG evidence remains bound to this entry.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: cdecl context at esp+4; index at esp+8 (esp+0xc after push esi). Explicit angr cdecl prototype is void*(void**,int).

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: edx starts at zero, increments by one for each successor; signed input is compared by bitwise equality. Compared INT_MIN, -1, zero, positive positions and INT_MAX.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Loads *context, then node[0] as next. Non-empty list and a trailing node with next=0 are preconditions. Fixture compares full 1024-byte arena in both executions.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No calls and no writes in retail instructions. Returns current node only while successor is non-null. Final node deliberately excluded, confirmed by all boundary fixtures.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: je at 0x004CF30D and fallthrough after successor test return zero; match branch returns current eax. Null heads and cyclic/invalid lists are outside the tested scope.

limitations: Valid finite non-empty lists only; invalid pointers, cycles and concurrent writes excluded.
Concrete emulation is not an original-game process or universal equivalence proof.
No independent second reviewer in this pass; status remains STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED.
